title: Quiet Steps
tuning: E A D G B E
learningGoal: Project a lyrical top-string melody over an even, quiet eighth-note arpeggio while maintaining a clear underlying bass pulse.
practiceInstructions: Fingerstyle only, no pick or percussion. Thumb p plays bass and fourth string, index i plays third, middle m second, ring a first. Start around 55 BPM. Practice bars 1–4 and 5–8 separately, then join them. Keep melody louder than accompaniment. String/fret markings are included in MusicXML; melody notes occur on first string.
successCriteria: Eight complete 4/4 measures with each voice rhythmically complete
Even eight eighth-note accompaniment attacks per bar without losing the underlying pulse
Distinct and audible upper melody, including the final dotted-half cadence
